Two former members of winning 'National' C.C. teams have been to our fixtures. On Boxing Day we had DICK TOBIN eyeing the field and FRANK ABBERTON was at the Surrey C.C.
One day though Dick Tobin says to me, 'Mac, you like going to the pictures don't you, well you're never going to get fit by staying up late.
At the end of the first lap of the country Dick Tobin was in front of a small bunch which included Clough and McIntyre (Southern Champion) of Thames and Carter and F.P.

Les Stokell was once again a good 7th man and Albert Frost and Dick Tobin completed our team. Positions were: 2 V.S.Blowfield; 12 L.W.Herbert; 15 E.S.Stimpson; 27 F.J.Abberton; 41 C.T.Carter; 57 T.P.Clinton; 64 C.L.Stokell; 95 A.E.Frost; 132 R.W.Tobin.
